text:
Maya: Quick AM check — what's our headroom in us-west-2? prepping a small canary for the v2 encoder and want to avoid evictions.
Jon: us-west-2 p4d pool shows ~12% headroom right now, but spot eviction rate spiked last night (3/hr). can still run a tiny canary but keep retries low.
Sasha: autoscaler added 2 nodes to pool-gpu-1 at 03:12, so that bought us some short-term buffer.
infra-bot: [alert] spot-eviction-rate warning — pool=pool-gpu-1 region=us-west-2 rate=3/hr
Liam: opened ticket to cloud support for a soft quota bump to 120 GPUs (ticket #98765). asked for ETA and justification attached.
Maya: thanks. if quota's slow, plan B is route canary to eu-west-1 small pool. less latency for some customers but ok for perf smoke.
Oliver: can we also prewarm prefix cache on the canary instances? should reduce per-token latency and keep requests under SLO.
Sasha: re: batching changes — pinging @Jon on PR#421 (batch default -> 8). need sim results before we flip in prod.
Jon: will run the simulator against sampled traffic and post numbers by 10:30. if batch=8 increases p50 latency > 150ms we should hold.
Dena: blocker: key rotation on a subset of dedicated nodes triggered auth failures for 2 replicas. rolling rollback in progress.
Maya: copy. Dena, if rollback needs manual capacity swaps pls call it out — we can hold the canary until you're green.
Jon: quick one-liner to fetch pool headroom if folks want to run locally:
```
curl -s https://infra-api.internal/pools/us-west-2 | jq '.pools[] | select(.name=="pool-gpu-1") | {idle_nodes,capacity,utilization}'
```
Sasha: nice. I'll run that and attach results to the ticket.
Liam: cloud support replied: asking for anticipated sustained vs burst usage. put a short note in the ticket.
Maya: added the usage table. cloud asked for an example request rate — I put 120 rps burst, 15 rps sustained for the canary.
deploy-bot: [info] canary job v2-encoder queued -> target=eu-west-1-small-pool
Sasha: :thumbsup: let's wait for Jon's sims and Dena's rollback confirmation. no hard rollout until both green.
Maya: agreed. if anything changes ping #oncall and drop the ticket link in thread.
Jon: will post sim summary in 10:25–10:30 window.
Dena: rollback finished, auth tests passing on the two replicas. marking as resolved.
Maya: excellent — thanks everyone. proceeding with eu-west-1 canary once sims look ok.
